reason: The gap focuses on the discrepancy in recording methods for prenatal care visits between two distinct datasets (NCFRP case series and PRAMS population reference). This is important because differences in how variables are recorded can introduce biases when comparing cases of SUID with a general population sample, potentially affecting the validity of any associations drawn from such comparisons. Understanding these discrepancies is crucial for refining study designs and improving data collection methods to ensure more accurate and reliable research findings.
